insert into u_patrol_result( task_id, task_code, task_name, area_id, task_type, execute_type, robot_id, task_source, task_level, task_state, modify_state, task_count, task_wait, check_user, check_date, weather, create_time, end_time, execute_time, is_review, task_abnormal, cruise_result, remark )values
( #{UPatrolResult.taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.taskCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.taskName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.areaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.taskType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.executeType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{UPatrolResult.taskSource, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.taskLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.taskState, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.modifyState, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.taskCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.taskWait, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.checkUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.checkDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{UPatrolResult.weather, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{UPatrolResult.endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{UPatrolResult.executeTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{UPatrolResult.isReview, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPatrolResult.taskAbnormal, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.cruiseResult, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{UPatrolResult.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.device_mete_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance d WHERE 1 = 1 and instance_id = #{instanceId}

SELECT ( SELECT count(*) FROM t_warn_info warn WHERE warn.task_id = #{taskId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} LIMIT 1 ) AS is_warn, a.instance_id, a.task_id, a.identify_result, a.person_check, a.picpath, a.modify_num, a.cruise_type, a.unit, a.device_mete_id, a.cruise_time FROM u_patrol_data_result a WHERE a.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND a.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT d.task_id, d.task_name, d.task_type as Type, d.task_state as 'taskState', b.dict_note AS 'taskStateName', e.dict_note AS 'typeName' FROM u_patrol_result d left JOIN t_dict_business e ON d.task_type = e.dict_code AND e.col_name = 'plan_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON d.task_state = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = 'task_state' WHERE d.task_state in (239, 241) ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.task_id, d.task_name, d.task_type as Type, a.task_state as 'taskState', b.dict_note AS 'taskStateName', e.dict_note AS 'typeName' FROM u_patrol_task d LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON d.task_type=e.dict_code AND e.col_name='plan_type' LEFT JOIN u_patrol_result a ON a.task_id=d.task_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.task_state=b.dict_code AND b.col_name='task_state' WHERE d.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN ( ( t_cruise_plan b JOIN u_patrol_plan_attr c ON b.plan_id = c.plan_id ) LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task d ON b.plan_id = d.plan_id ) ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE d.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT dict_code as"cruiseType", dict_note as "cruiseTypeName", ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task_attr c ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task d ON c.task_id = d.task_code WHERE a.cruise_type=dict_code AND d.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS "Count" FROM t_dict_business WHERE dict_code IN(SELECT dict_code FROM t_dict_business WHERE col_name="cruise_type" ORDER BY dict_code)
SELECT a.instance_id FROM u_patrol_task_attr a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT k.device_id as'deviceId', m.device_name, k.instance_id as 'instanceId', c.save_type_list, n.cruise_type as 'cruiseType', e.dict_note as 'cruiseTypeName', n.unit, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName FROM u_patrol_task_attr k LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance n ON k.instance_id = n.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON n.cruise_type=e.dict_code AND e.col_name='cruise_type' LEFT JOIN t_std_device m on m.device_id = n.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON n.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON n.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON n.cruise_id = d.preset_id WHERE k.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY instanceId

select dict_code , dict_note , (select COUNT(*) from u_patrol_result a where 1=1 and task_type = dict_code and a.task_state != 239 and a.task_state != 241 and a.task_state != 238 and a.execute_time BETWEEN #{start} and #{end} ) AS "count" from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = #{colName1} ) ORDER BY dict_code

select dict_code as cruise_abnormal, dict_note as abnormal_type, ( (select COUNT(*) from u_patrol_data_result WHERE cruise_abnormal = dict_code) + (select COUNT(*) from u_patrol_data_result WHERE remark = dict_code) ) AS "count" from t_dict_business where col_name = 'abnormal_type' ORDER BY dict_code;

SELECT count(*) FROM t_std_devicemete WHERE device_mete_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a.device_mete_id FROM u_patrol_plan_attr a LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM u_patrol_plan_attr a LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND c.cruise_type IN (229, 230) UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM u_patrol_plan_attr a LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND c.cruise_type = 228 UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM u_patrol_plan_attr a LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task b ON a.plan_id = b.plan_id WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: update u_patrol_data_result set person_check = #{personCheck}, modify_num = #{modifyNum}, identify_result = #{identifyResult,jdbcType=INTEGER}, evaluation_state = 256, check_user = #{checkUser}, check_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, identify_state = #{identifyState,jdbcType=INTEGER} where cruise_data_id = #{cruiseDataId,jdbcType =BIGINT }

UPDATE u_patrol_data_result SET person_check = IF ( evaluation_state = 256, person_check, result_desc ), check_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, check_user = #{checkUser}, identify_result = IF(evaluation_state = 256, identify_result, IF (cruise_result = 246, 261, 264)), identify_state = IF(evaluation_state = 256, identify_state, IF (cruise_result = 246, 258, 259)), evaluation_state = 256, modify_num = result_num WHERE task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND evaluation_state = 257

update u_patrol_data_result set person_check = #{personCheck}, identify_result = #{identifyResult,jdbcType=INTEGER}, evaluation_state = 256, check_user = #{checkUser}, check_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, identify_state = #{identifyState,jdbcType=INTEGER} where task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType =VARCHAR} and instance_id = #{instanceId,jdbcType =BIGINT}

update t_std_devicemete_update a a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId}, a.update_time = #{updateTime}, a.cruise_result = #{cruiseResult}, a.identify_result = #{identifyResult}, a.pic_path = #{picPath},
where a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.update_time <= #{updateTime}
mapper.select: select a.device_mete_id, a.device_id, a.custom_id, a.mete_id, a.mete_kind, a.mete_type, a.mete_name, a.device_type, a.position_type, a.unit, a.alarm_note, a.alarm_type, a.up_effect, a.down_effect, a.state_zero, a.state_one, a.alarm_state, a.alarm_level, a.high_limit1, a.low_limit1, a.high_limit2, a.low_limit2, a.high_limit3, a.low_limit3, a.high_limit4, a.low_limit4, a.alarm_delay, a.alarm_cnt, a.threshold_abs, a.threshold_per, a.modulus, a.is_temdif, a.remark, conf.db_value as dBValue, conf.f_value as FValue from t_cruise_point_instance b left join t_std_devicemete a on b.device_mete_id=a.device_mete_id left join t_voice_device v on b.cruise_id = v.voice_device_id left join t_voice_config conf on v.config_id = conf.config_id where b.instance_id=#{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.update:
update u_patrol_result a a.check_user = #{checkUserName}, a.check_date = #{checkDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, a.remark = #{remark},
where a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

UPDATE t_warn_info a a.warn_name = #{warnName}, a.warn_level = #{warnLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, a.warn_content = #{warnContent}, a.conf_mode = 275, a.deal_type = #{dealType}, a.deal_info = #{dealInfo}, a.out_range = #{outRange}, a.deal_person_id = #{dealPersonId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.deal_time = #{dealTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
WHERE a.warn_id = #{warnId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE t_warn_info a a.conf_mode = 275, a.deal_type = 286, a.deal_info = '程序正常，告警属实', a.deal_person_id = #{dealPersonId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.deal_time = #{dealTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.conf_mode = 276

UPDATE u_patrol_data_result a a.is_warn = 1
WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.instance_id = #{instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT a.warn_id, a.warn_name, a.alarm_owner FROM t_warn_info a WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.instance_id = #{instanceId,jdbcType = BIGINT}
SELECT a.analyse_type FROM t_std_devicemete a WHERE a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType = BIGINT}
SELECT b.cruise_data_id, b.cruise_result, b.result_num, b.task_id, b.instance_id FROM u_patrol_data_result b WHERE 1 = 1 and b.task_id = #{taskId} and ISNULL(b.check_user)

SELECT b.task_id, b.cruise_data_id, b.evaluation_state, e.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, b.check_user, b.check_date, b.cruise_time FROM u_patrol_data_result b LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on e.dict_code = b.evaluation_state WHERE 1 = 1 and b.task_id = #{taskResultId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.task_name, d.execute_time as cruise_date, d.task_count as total, d.task_wait as wait, d.task_count - task_wait as already, d.task_abnormal as abnormal, d.task_count - d.task_abnormal as normal, (SELECT count(1) from u_patrol_data_result WHERE c.check_user IS NULL)as unReview, MIN(d.execute_time) as cruiseStartTime, MAX(d.end_time) as cruiseEndTime, d.check_user as reviewer, d.weather as envInfo, d.check_date as reviewTime from u_patrol_task a left join u_patrol_result d on a.task_id = d.task_id left join u_patrol_data_result c on c.task_id = a.task_id where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT a.remark FROM u_patrol_result a where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.sql: select f.cruise_data_id, f.device_id, f.device_name, b.device_mete_id, h.instance_id, f.instance_name, b.mete_type, q.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, p.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.picpath, f.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, f.cruise_time, a.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type FROM u_patrol_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_info h on h.instance_id = f.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device a on a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result AND g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business p on p.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and p.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business q on q.dict_code = b.mete_type and q.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result'

select q.task_id, f.cruise_data_id, f.device_id, f.device_name, b.device_mete_id, f.instance_id, f.instance_name, b.mete_type, w.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, x.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.picpath, F.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, f.cruise_time, y.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type from u_patrol_result q LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result f on f.task_id = q.task_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_info h on h.instance_id = f.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device y on y.device_id = f.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result and g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business w on w.dict_code = b.mete_type and w.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business x on x.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and x.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result'
mapper.select:
SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and a.device_id in
#{deviceIds, jdbcType=BIGINT}
and cruise_time between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and q.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

select f.task_id, f.cruise_data_id, f.device_id, f.device_name, b.device_mete_id, f.instance_id, f.instance_name, b.mete_type, w.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, x.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, f.result_num, f.result_desc, f.picpath as picPath, F.cruise_result, g.dict_note as cruise_result_name, f.cruise_time, a.real_code, f.person_check, f.identify_result, z.dict_note as identify_result_name, f.cruise_type, f.origpic as ori_img, n.dict_note as dataType, b.custom_id, b.custom_name as componentName, a.up_region_name as intervalName, m.region_name as regionName, f.cruise_status as cruiseState, f.cruise_abnormal as cruiseAbnormal, f.is_warn from u_patrol_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance h on h.instance_id = f.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on b.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_result and g.col_name = 'cruise_result' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business w on w.dict_code = b.mete_type and w.col_name = 'mete_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business x on x.dict_code = f.evaluation_state and x.col_name = 'evaluation_state' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z on z.dict_code = f.identify_result and z.col_name = 'identify_result' LEFT JOIN t_std_device a on a.device_id = f.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region d on d.region_id = a.up_region_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region m on m.region_id = d.up_region_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business n on n.dict_code = f.cruise_type and n.col_name = 'cruise_type' where 1 = 1 and f.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER by cruise_time
SELECT count(cruise_data_id) as num from u_patrol_data_result where 1 = 1 and task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select f.task_id as taskId, c.task_code as taskCode, c.task_name as taskName, c.area_id as areaId, c.task_type as taskType, c.execute_type as executeType, c.robot_id as robotId, c.task_source as taskSource, c.task_level as taskLevel, f.cruise_status as taskState, "" as modifyState, "" as taskCount, "" as taskWait, f.check_user as checkUser, f.check_date as checkDate, "" as weather, c.create_time as createTime, c.end_time as endTime, c.start_time as executeTime, f.evaluation_state as evaluationState, f.cruise_abnormal as cruiseAbnormal, f.cruise_result as cruiseResult, "" as remark from u_patrol_task c LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result f on c.task_id = f.task_id where 1 = 1 and f.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER by f.cruise_time limit 1
select count(cruise_data_id) from u_patrol_data_result where cruise_status = 253 and f.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select count(1) total_count, count(IF(a.cruise_result = 247, a.cruise_result, null)) abnormal_count, count(IF(a.task_state in (239, 241), a.task_state, null)) running_count from u_patrol_result a

SELECT is_ai as ai,is_judge as judge,device_mete_id as deviceMeteId FROM t_std_devicemete WHERE device_mete_id IN ( SELECT device_mete_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId})

SELECT DISTINCT ins.warn_id, poi.instance_id_one one, poi.instance_id_two two, '' three from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection ins left join t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn warn on ins.warn_id = warn.warn_id left join t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance poi on warn.instance_id = poi.instance_id where task_id = #{taskId} union all( SELECT DISTINCT ins.warn_id, rule.instance_one_id one, rule.instance_two_id two, rule.instance_tri_id three from t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn_inspection ins left join t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn warn on ins.warn_id = warn.warn_id left join t_cruise_triphase_rule rule on warn.instance_id = rule.triphase_id where task_id = #{taskId} )
